candidate_merges.message: Add dashboard resource-selector dropdown (#21861) ## Description Make resource switching available while the dashboard sidebar is collapsed, without reopening the full sidebar. This extracts only the resource-selector dropdown from #21793. ### User-facing usage Click the resource-name button to open the searchable resource list. Normal selection closes it; Ctrl/Cmd/Shift selection keeps it open. Selecting all closes it. Mobile retains the existing drawer. ### Validation - Passed: **1,394 compone
